title: Web3 is dead? Why crypto developers are pivoting to AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Web3 is dead? Crypto devs are ditching blockchain for AI — and here's why.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Web3 promised a decentralized internet, but it's stalled — and AI is moving fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Top crypto devs are now building AI tools that learn from decentralized data networks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They're using blockchain to create secure, transparent training data sets for AI models.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This shift is reshaping how AI is developed — and who controls it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Web3 isn't dead — it's evolving into the AI era.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know which AI startups are leading this charge? Follow for the breakdown.
